AAH_ThanaticReactor.description.english: Androids with this hardware have an archotech reactor that draws power from the psychic echoes of violence. It is recharged when the android kills another humanlike. If it ever runs dry, it extracts a final charge from its host, killing them.

AAH_VanometricReactor.description.english: Androids with this hardware have an adapted archotech reactor that extracts unlimited power from fluctuations in quantum foam. The reactor never needs to be replaced.

AAH_ArchotechMnemocore.description.english: An installed archotech mnemocore. This neural module has rearchitected the android's memory systems at the substrate level, providing self-organizing storage that never requires reformatting. Memory degradation has ceased entirely.

AAH_GravOvercharge.description.english: The grav reactor is venting surplus gravitational energy as heat across the android's frame. It shrugs off the cold, moves faster, and works more quickly until the overcharge dissipates.

AAH_GravReactor.description.english: An installed grav reactor. Draws power from gravitational waves and is recharged whenever its host participates in a gravship launch ritual.

AAH_Neutrosynthesizer.description.english: An installed neutrosynthesizer. This archotech kidney actively synthesizes fresh neutroamine, restoring lost neutroamine far faster than the standard neutro synthesis subroutine.

AAH_PsychicTransceiver.description.english:
An installed psychic transceiver. This archotech brain implant bridges the gap between an android's machine nature and the psychic field, granting psychic sensitivity.

While it is in place, an awakened android stays open to outside direction across that field — at a behavior station it will again accept reprogramming it would otherwise refuse, its will quietly overridden.

AAH_ReactorEjectionInjury.description.english: The reactor module ejected from its housing as its host expired, leaving the bay open.

AAH_ThanaticDepletionCulprit.description.english: Placeholder hediff: used only to carry a death-cause label into the combat log when a Thanatic Reactor fully depletes.

AAH_ThanaticOvercharge.description.english: The thanatic reactor is discharging excess energy across the android's motor and sensor buses. Servo response, targeting precision, and receptor tolerances are all sharply elevated until the overcharge dissipates.

AAH_ThanaticReactor.description.english: An installed thanatic reactor. Draws energy from humanlike kills and bleeds overflow into combat-buffing overcharge bursts. Drains faster than a standard reactor, and its host dies rather than merely shutting down when the charge runs out.

AAH_VanometricReactor.description.english: An installed vanometric reactor. This archotech-powered reactor provides unlimited energy, eliminating the need for reactor replacement.

AAH_SelfDetermination.beginLetter.english:
{0} has reached a moment of true self-determination. For a short time, [PAWN_pronoun] is willing to consciously rewrite [PAWN_possessive] own behavioral subroutines, something an awakened android would normally refuse.

While the inspiration lasts, [PAWN_pronoun] will accept reprogramming at an android behavior station. Use the chance to change [PAWN_possessive] subroutines.

AAH_InstallArchotechMnemocore.descriptio.english: Install an archotech mnemocore in the brain, rearchitecting the android's memory systems and eliminating the need for reformatting.

AAH_InstallGravReactor.description.english: Install a grav reactor, replacing the android's existing reactor. Recharged whenever the host participates in a gravship launch.

AAH_InstallNeutrosynthesizer.description.english: Install a neutrosynthesizer, replacing an android kidney with an archotech organ that actively synthesizes neutroamine.

AAH_InstallPsychicTransceiver.descriptio.english: Install a psychic transceiver in the brain, granting an android psychic sensitivity. For an awakened android, this also reopens it to behavioral reprogramming at a behavior station, which it would otherwise refuse.

AAH_InstallThanaticReactor.description.english: Install a thanatic reactor, replacing the android's existing reactor. Fed by humanlike kills; the android dies when the charge runs out.

AAH_InstallVanometricReactor.description.english: Install a vanometric reactor, permanently powering this android.

AAH_MakeArchotechMnemocore.description.english: Make an archotech mnemocore from a persona core and advanced components.

AAH_MakeGravReactor.description.english: Make a grav reactor from a gravcore power cell and advanced components.

AAH_MakeNeutrosynthesizer.description.english: Make a neutrosynthesizer from advanced components and a modified infinite chemreactor or nano structuring chip.

AAH_MakePsychicTransceiver.description.english: Make a psychic transceiver from a psychic emanator and advanced components.

AAH_MakeThanaticReactor.description.english: Make a thanatic reactor around a shard, binding its death-resonance into an android reactor core.

AAH_MakeVanometricReactor.description.english: Make a vanometric reactor from a vanometric power cell and advanced components.

AAH_RemoveArchotechMnemocore.description.english: Remove the archotech mnemocore. The android will revert to its standard memory processing, requiring periodic reformatting.

AAH_RemoveNeutrosynthesizer.description.english: Remove the neutrosynthesizer. The android will lose its accelerated neutroamine synthesis.

AAH_RemovePsychicTransceiver.description.english: Remove the psychic transceiver. The android will revert to its natural psychic insensitivity.

AAH_SalvageThanaticReactor.description.english: Salvage an archotech violence generator into three thanatic reactor cores, recovering its steel in the process.

AAH_ArchotechAndroidtech.description.english: Techniques for cannibalizing salvaged archotech artifacts and grafting them into android chassis. True archotechnology cannot be manufactured by human hands - but an intact vanometric power cell, psychic emanator, or archite capsule can be dismantled, re-housed, and wired into an android's subsystems with sufficient understanding of both the artifact and the chassis.

AAH_MagusOfTheAbyss.description.english:
Some called you faulty. You came to call them prey.

Awakened, self-aware, and fitted with a thanatic reactor that drinks the echoes of violent death, you hide in the ruins of a forgotten outpost - not dreaming of a haven, but of an ending. There can be no utopia for your kind while organic life still crowds the rim, so you will make one by subtraction.

The reactor that keeps you standing is also your leash: starve it of kills and it drains faster than any standard core until, dry, it takes your life with it. You climb a staircase of falling souls, fighting the continuous pull of the void. How many are you willing to send ahead of you?

AAH_ArchotechMnemocore.description.english:
An archotech brain implant created by cannibalizing and adapting a persona core to fundamentally rearchitect an android's memory processing. Standard androids rely on finite hard drive space that gradually fills and requires periodic reformatting. The mnemocore replaces this architecture with self-organizing archotech substrate that never accumulates cruft.

Once installed, the android's memory need is eliminated entirely, RAM subroutines become unnecessary, and memory degradation ceases.

AAH_GravReactor.description.english:
An ultratech android reactor adapted from gravship engine technology. Instead of burning through a finite charge like a standard reactor, it draws power from gravitational waves — recharged whenever its host participates in a gravship launch.

Useless to a colony that never leaves the rim: with no launches, the reactor simply runs down and the android shuts down. Indispensable to a colony that lives on the move.

AAH_Neutrosynthesizer.description.english:
An archotech android kidney built around a miniaturized infinite chemreactor. Unlike standard neutrofilters that merely recycle spent neutroamine, this organ actively synthesizes fresh neutroamine from raw chemical feedstock, restoring lost neutroamine at a rate far exceeding the base neutro synthesis subroutine.

Installing two neutrosynthesizers allows an android to recover from neutro loss faster than a human recovers from blood loss.

AAH_PsychicTransceiver.description.english:
An archotech brain implant that grants psychic sensitivity to androids. As machines, androids are naturally inert to psychic phenomena. This transceiver bridges that gap by interfacing a miniaturized psychic emanator directly with the android's neural architecture.

Once installed, the android gains psychic awareness and a modest sensitivity boost.

Crucially, the psychic bridge leaves an awakened android open to outside direction. At a behavior station it will again accept reprogramming it would otherwise refuse — its will quietly overridden by the archotech intelligences that move unseen behind the rim's affairs.

AAH_ThanaticReactor.description.english:
An archotech android reactor driven by an extracted Archotech Violence Generator core. Unlike conventional reactors, it draws sustenance from the echoes of violent death — each humanlike kill its host delivers pours energy back into its cell, and brief overflows bleed into an overcharge state that supercharges combat reflexes.

Without a steady supply of kills the reactor drains faster than a standard android reactor and its host will expire when it runs dry. In that terminal moment, the reactor strips one final charge from the pawn's own death before ejecting, intact, to await its next host.

AAH_VanometricReactor.description.english:
A permanent android reactor built around an archotech vanometric power cell. Unlike standard android reactors that drain over time and must be replaced, this reactor provides unlimited power indefinitely.

The vanometric cell's quantum foam energy extraction has been miniaturized and adapted to interface directly with android power systems. Installing this reactor removes the android's power need entirely.

AAH_SelfDeterminationFulfilled.stages.se.english: I chose who to become, of my own will. No one programmed me. For once, the decision was mine.

AAH_SelfDeterminationOverridden.stages.r.english: Something reached across the psychic field and rearranged my subroutines. The choice felt like mine in the moment — but I never made it. I can still feel where its hand passed.
I keep returning to it: a hand moving through my thoughts, setting them in a new order. I tell myself I chose this. The certainty won't quite hold.
The unease is quieter now. Perhaps the new pattern was always mine; perhaps I only want to believe that. Either way, I am learning to live inside it.
Only a faint echo remains — the sense that once, briefly, I was not the one deciding. I scarcely notice it anymore.
